text: Docs/wording drift: undocumented 200-participant cap; currency 'fixed for life' vs server that only forbids blanking

Fixed in 3419739. Decision taken: the server now enforces what both clients already promised — on an expenses list a currency write that differs from the stored value is 422 invalid_field with row_id/field whatever its clock, mirroring the kind rule; the same value re-sent is accepted (Android pushes the whole list row). Documented in the wire contract alongside kind, plus the previously undocumented 200-participant cap per share map. Verified no client flow writes currency after creation (OverviewPage create handler, ListsRepo.create only). Three new server tests, mutation-checked.
